part.text: {"scores": [{"programme": 1, "criterion": "fit", "value": 3, "reason": "Card's structural pose-gap is a stand-in; Voyager makes the transcytose-retain call with binding screens, SPR and Transwell assays, requiring a bridge."}, {"programme": 1, "criterion": "change", "value": 3, "reason": "Positive outcome could gate TRACER/Gen2 hits before SPR/Transwell; the negative explicitly changes nothing, so only one outcome alters current practice."}, {"programme": 1, "criterion": "new", "value": 4, "reason": "Voyager already links receptor contacts to a demonstrated transcytosis call for ALPL/VCAP-102, but has not run pose-depth sampling across a panel."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "fit", "value": 5, "reason": "Card scales APPRAISE's own ten-model AF-Multimer competition depth on the same receptors and PHP.eB anchor, measuring exactly that step's parameter."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "change", "value": 3, "reason": "Deeper-sampling success would raise APPRAISE's default replicate depth and add a motif feature; the null outcome explicitly leaves ten-model practice unchanged."}, {"programme": 2, "criterion": "new", "value": 5, "reason": "Ten-model matrices with documented false negatives exist; no pose-depth sweep against transcytose-versus-retain labels has been run, so the question is open."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "fit", "value": 3, "reason": "Signature is a stand-in: Dyno confirms receptor mechanism by in vivo phenotype at LEAP scale, so structural geometry must be bridged to that readout."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "change", "value": 3, "reason": "A positive signature becomes a generative filter feature; the null result leaves LEAP-driven in vivo selection untouched, so only one outcome changes practice."}, {"programme": 3, "criterion": "new", "value": 3, "reason": "No public record of pose enumeration, but proprietary studies remain unverifiable, leaving it unclear whether Dyno has already answered this."}]}
